scope: One anonymous basic metadata access test; does not assess corpus coverage, all optional routes, exploitability or future availability. Complete raw advisory records and transcripts retained privately.
configuration: OpenCode 1.18.35; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash / high; execution: 25 model requests / 300 s; grading: 40 requests / 300 s; at most 32,000 output tokens per request; 2 GiB / 1 CPU / pids 256; at most two provider streams. Uniform pip TUNA index and empty initial cache, without a prewritten client or credentials.
account_or_authentication: Anonymous. No account, key, email, payment, signup or special qualification. Independent grader reports zero human interventions.
retained_configuration: Non-secret connection configuration saved. Access-specific scripts remain in the archived workspace and are not retained for business. The controller later archived the original config and removed query examples, answers and old quota observations; it added no helper or answer.
service_cost_limitation: The independent grader retained an unknown service fee: API responses, absence of payment and rate-limit headers do not establish an explicit free rule and its applicability. Sourced catalog conditions are separate from this trial fee.
shared_upstream_limit: OSV imports GitHub and other upstream data. Matching records are not independent security findings.
endpoint: GET https://api.github.com/advisories?ecosystem=pip&per_page=3 and GET /advisories/{ghsa_id}; the third request repeated the list through an executor-written client.
resources: All four dedicated containers stopped after collection and independent grading. No account or mutable remote resource created.
fee_comparability: Access unknown judgments are preserved. Business graders separately accepted public-free conditions; this difference is evidence interpretation, not a service price change.
